boundary: This executes and certifies a complete nontrivial shard and the exact global resource/merge contract. It does not claim the global sixth-order singleton coefficient; the remaining computation is data-volume limited, not mathematically unspecified.
completion_manifest: Generate and sort all fixed-coordinate weight-six chart shards with 16-byte (syndrome,combinadic-rank) records.
Generate and merge every weight-0/2/4 lower-shadow syndrome shard.
Enumerate all connecting codewords of weights 4,6,8,10,12 through the fixed coordinate.
Mark every complementary half-coset representative in the 6,230,484,547-bit bitmap.
Count nonlower chart singleton syndromes whose sole representative is unmarked, then multiply by 40.

external_memory_ledger.reason: A weight-six error containing one fixed coordinate is globalized by 240/6=40 only after chart singleton, lower-shadow, and every external-partner mark are deduplicated.

pilot_interpretation: The shard fixes coordinates 0,1,2 and enumerates every remaining triple. Its singleton and lower-shadow counts are exact for that shard, but a shard singleton may still collide with an error in another chart shard or outside the fixed-coordinate chart.
theorem: The U6 pipeline is now exercised on a literal 2,190,670-error shard, including exact internal syndrome multiplicities and exact lower-shadow removal. The complete chart requires a 99,687,752,752-byte sorted record stream and a 778,810,569-byte external-partner bitmap. No U6 coefficient is promoted until every shard and external codeword family is merged.
